title: wg: room-policy-04 §7 time units and ordering unstated
description: Suggestion. §7 MinDefaultMaxTime and the *_lifetime fields give no units (seconds? ms?), and no ordering rules (min <= default <= max; minimum_delay_ms <= maximum_delay_ms; consistency of mandatory/default/forbidden capability lists). mimid carries them without checks (decisions mimid-1wgh.3.45, .3.64). Fix: state units and constraints.
